query: SELECT DISTINCT mem.member_id FROM kb_cogmap_regions r JOIN kb_cogmap_region_members mem ON mem.region_id = r.id JOIN kb_resources res ON res.id = mem.member_id WHERE r.home_anchor_table = $1 AND r.home_anchor_id = $2 AND NOT r.is_folded AND mem.member_table = 'kb_resources' AND res.erased_at IS NOT NULL
